caveat: When operated in FIPS mode and with the tamper evident seals and external baffles installed as indicated in the Security Policy. The protocol SNMP shall not be used when operated in FIPS mode.
description: The S5720 series Ethernet switches are next-generation energy-saving switches developed by Huawei to meet the demand for high-bandwidth access and Ethernet multi-service aggregation. Based on cutting-edge hardware and Huawei Versatile Routing Platform (VRP) software, the S5720 provides a large switching capacity, high reliability (double power slots and hardware Ethernet OAM), and high-density GE ports to accommodate 10 Gbit/s upstream transmissions. The S5720 is available in a lite (LI) series, a standard (SI) series, an enhanced (EI) series, and a hyper (HI) series.
